title: Preferences store and option memory
summary: Validated preferences record in localStorage (formvis.prefs): loadPrefs clamps every field to its default, updatePrefs merges and saves, recalled/remembered keep per-dialog values, installOptionMemory makes tool options stick. Fields are data; the pattern is the slot.
description: Reading never throws: `loadPrefs()` parses the JSON and validates each field (type, range, enum) against `DEFAULT_PREFS`, so a bad or old file degrades field by field. `updatePrefs(patch)` merges and writes. `recalled(dialog, name)` and `remembered(dialog, name, value)` back `Dialog.remember`. `installOptionMemory(engine)` wraps each tool `options` so a changed value is kept as `tool.option`, a value equal to the tool default is not kept (a later default change still reaches everyone), and options that describe the document or gesture are skipped (`skipped`). `prefs.ts` is heavily coupled to the formvis engine (renderer, tiling, workers); a port keeps the pattern and replaces the field list. Imports ./themes (this corpus), ./i18n/langs and ./colour-settings (not seeded).
statusReason: seeded from B06 for the owner to confirm

exports.signature: export interface Prefs extends PagePrefs { language: Lang; profileMismatch: MismatchPref; colour: ColourSettings; colourPresets: ColourPreset[]; shortcuts: Record<string, string[]>; restoreSession: boolean; agentsAllowed: boolean; comfyuiUrl: string; nodemodeUrl: string; historyStates: number; historyMB: number; historyAuto: boolean; memoryLimitMB: number; effectCacheMB: number; backgroundReleaseSec: number; backgroundCacheMB: number; memoryReserveMB: number; cacheLevels: number; regionRedraws: boolean; layerReuse: boolean; fullPreviews: boolean; recoverySeconds: number; autoShowHome: boolean; useGpu: boolean; gpuFilters: boolean; renderer: GpuRenderer; gpuMemoryMB: number; gpuPower: GpuPower; lowLatency: boolean; hdrDisplay: boolean; framePacingMs: number; cacheTilePx: number; tileFromMp: number; workerThreads: number; workerComposite: boolean; engineDevice: EngineDevice; { ... }
exports.doc: Preferences that change how formvis works, kept on this device. Every one acts on something real: History States and history memory are the undo limits every project uses;
Preferences > Scratch Disks, Cursors, Transparency & Gamut, Units & Rulers, Guides Grid & Slices, Plug-ins, Type and Enhanced Controls.
Defaults for PagePrefs.

exports.signature: export type ToolOptionValue = string | number | boolean
exports.doc: A value a tool option keeps: string, number or boolean.
A value a dialog control keeps: string or boolean.
The default for every preference; loadPrefs falls back to it field by field.

exports.signature: export function cleanBindings(v: unknown): Record<string, string[]>
exports.doc: A binding map (command id to combinations), strings only: what a saved set or an imported file may hold.
Reads formvis.prefs from localStorage and validates every field (type, range, enum) against DEFAULT_PREFS; never throws, a bad file degrades field by field.
Writes the whole Prefs object to localStorage; a storage failure keeps the values for the session only.

exports.signature: export const recalled = (dialog: string, name: string): DialogValue | undefined => ...
exports.doc: A value a dialog kept under `name` (see `Dialog.remember`), for dialogs that hold their settings as an object.

exports.signature: export function remembered(dialog: string, name: string, value: DialogValue): void
exports.doc: Keeps `value` for a dialog under `name`; nothing is written when it is already what is kept.
Changes some preferences and keeps them: what a tool option, a dialog or What's New remembers goes through here.
Scales the interface's font-size tokens (--fs-9 to --fs-18) to the chosen size, and the rules that still write a size in pixels with them.
Interface scale: the whole window zoomed (CSS zoom on the root in the browser, the web view's own zoom in the desktop app), kept on this device (the View > Interface Zoom commands use the same key).
The stored interface zoom choice (formvis.uiZoom), 1 when unset or unknown.
The zoom the desktop window already holds (its shell reports it): a zoomed web view reports a larger pixel ratio, which Auto divides out.
What Auto means: a display the system already scales (devicePixelRatio above 1) is left at 100%; one reported at 1 that is 3000 pixels wide or more gets 150%, and from 3800 pixels 200%.
Stores the interface zoom choice under formvis.uiZoom and fires formvis:ui-zoom.
Preferences > Plugins > Updates: whether the desktop app looks for a new version when it starts (on unless turned off).
Stores the update-at-start choice.

exports.signature: export function applyPrefs(engine: Engine, p: Prefs): void
exports.doc: Pushes preferences into the engine and renderer settings (cache levels, frame pacing, tiling, worker threads, memory limits and more).

exports.signature: export const skipped = (tool: string, label: string): boolean => ...
exports.doc: Whether an option describes the document or the gesture (never kept); Tool Presets (35.3) skip the same ones.

exports.signature: export interface OptionMemory { reset(toolId?: string): number }
exports.doc: What the option memory lets the rest of the app do: put one tool's options, or every tool's, back to their defaults.
Wraps each tool options so a changed value is kept as tool.option in Preferences and put back at start; returns an OptionMemory.

invariants.text: loadPrefs and savePrefs never throw: reads validate each field against its default, writes swallow storage failure and keep the value for the session.
A tool option equal to the tool default is not kept, so a later change of the default still reaches everyone who never moved it.
Every localStorage read and write is wrapped in try/catch.

examples.title: Remember a value for a dialog or panel
examples.snippet: try { const v = JSON.parse(String(recalled('Brush Picker', 'recent') ?? '[]')); return Array.isArray(v) ? v.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string').slice(0, 8) : []; } catch { return []; }
examples.whenToUse: Read a remembered value that is not a form control.

examples.title: Keep a value as it changes
examples.snippet: if (id && this.before && id !== this.before.id) remembered('Brush Picker', 'recent', JSON.stringify([id, ...this.recent().filter((x) => x !== id)].slice(0, 8)));
examples.whenToUse: Write it back when it changes; unchanged values are not rewritten.

examples.title: Install option memory at boot
examples.snippet: const optionMemory = installOptionMemory(engine);   // every tool option sticks (DEV_PLAN 35.1), before the bar and the catalogue read the options
examples.whenToUse: Before the options bar and the command catalogue read tool options.
